section_summary.extract_value: This section reports results from a concurrent multiple indirect-effects model examining BMI, family fat talk, general body appreciation (BAS-2), functional body appreciation (FBApS), and mindful eating. The model accounted for 20% of variance in mindful eating and found a significant indirect effect of family fat talk on mindful eating via functional body appreciation (β = −0.06, p = .01), whereas the indirect effect via general body appreciation (BAS-2) was not significant; no study numbering or sample descriptives are provided in the section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: 'The full model accounted for 20% of the variance in mindful eating scores (BMI: β = −0.01...; BAS-2: β = 0.10...; FBApS: β = 0.35, p < .001...)' and 'As predicted, a significant indirect effect of family fat talk on mindful eating via functional body appreciation was observed (β = −0.06, p = .01...)'.
